title: Battle of Grotniki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Grotniki", at revision 1370442093, opens: "The Battle of Grotniki took place either on 4 or 6 May 1439 in the vicinity of Grotniki Duże, a village near Nowy Korczyn, currently in Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q839234, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1439 battle of the Post-Hussite Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
